PreventingSleepBody: You can still put your PC to sleep manually.

AllowingSleepBody: Your PC will go to sleep when unused.

ActivateOnLaunchHint: Immediately starts preventing sleep when launched.
ShowNotifications: Show notifications when a session starts or ends

DurationsHint: The default activation duration is used when you click the tray icon.
DurationAlreadyAdded: This duration has already been added.
DurationInvalid: The entered duration is invalid. Please try again.
ResetDurationsMessage: Do you really want to reset the activation durations to the default values?

BatteryThresholdHint: This value is ignored when you manually start a session below this battery capacity.

NoBattery: No battery was detected on this PC.

WatchedItemToggleHint: Uncheck to pause an item without removing it.
TriggersNeedEnablingHint: Downloads and Active Hours also need their switch in the Advanced tab.
AdvancedHint: Only change these advanced settings if you know what you are doing.

DeactivateOnUserSwitch: Deactivate when switched to another user account

HideCountdown: Hide the remaining time in the tray icon tooltip

AboutDescription: Prevents your PC from going to sleep — for a set time, or while a trigger such as a running app, a Wi-Fi network or a download stays active.
